field_provenance.smoothing: Gaussian only on A(X), followed by one global factor so A never exceeds each original source-depth bound; preserve the original per-X source-depth transition and compact X window. No Z mixing and no source geometry smoothing.
field_provenance.limitations: A-only smoothing preserves the continuous per-X depth-mapping bound; interpolation and final triangulation still require actual profile checks. Final STL profiles and appearance require independent checks.

deformation: Additional compact lip-only inward offset relative to v18. Transition coordinates use original outer-surface depth; only retraction amplitude is smoothed across X and capped by source depth bounds before compact tapering. All X/Z and outside-lip vertices fixed; inner/outer wall share the field.
